SELECT r.reservation_code AS reservationCode, r.class_code AS classCode, r.member_code AS memberCode, c.name AS className, c.operator_code AS operatorCode, cr.activity_name AS activityName, img.image AS classImg, c.address AS address, TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD(DY) HH24:MI') AS reservationDate, TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD(DY) HH24:MI') AS classDate,
CASE WHEN r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%' THEN r.status WHEN r.reservation_date < SYSDATE THEN '수강완료' ELSE r.status END AS classStatus,
/* 💡 NVL을 사용하여 리뷰가 없으면 0, 있으면 review_code를 반환 */ NVL(rev.review_code, 0) AS reviewCode
FROM reservation r JOIN class c ON r.class_code = c.class_code LEFT JOIN creator cr ON c.operator_code = cr.operator_code LEFT JOIN class_img img ON c.class_code = img.class_code AND img.type = '대표' AND img.sort_order = 1
/* 💡 MEMBER_CODE와 CLASS_CODE 기준으로 리뷰 테이블 LEFT JOIN */ LEFT JOIN review rev ON r.class_code = rev.class_code AND r.member_code = rev.member_code
WHERE r.member_code = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode})
AND NOT (r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%') AND r.reservation_date >= SYSDATE
AND NOT (r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%') AND (r.status IN ('수강완료', '이용 완료') OR r.reservation_date < SYSDATE)
AND (r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%')
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.reservation_code DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = '취소' WHERE reservation_code = TO_NUMBER(#{reservationCode}) AND member_code = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode}) AND reservation_date >= SYSDATE AND status NOT LIKE '%취소%' AND status NOT LIKE '%환불%'
UPDATE payment SET status = '환불완료', refund = amount, refund_date = SYSDATE WHERE reservation_code = TO_NUMBER(#{reservationCode})
